create_dataloader: create a data loader by calling CreateDataLoader with an opt configuration object
initialize_dataloader: initialize the CustomDatasetDataLoader with opt settings including batchSize and nThreads
load_audiovisual_data: load audiovisual dataset batches by iterating over the returned data loader
get_dataset_length: get the total number of samples in the dataset using len on the data loader
create_dataset: create an AudioVisualDataset by calling CreateDataset with opt.model set to audioVisual
